svg.title: Parts list of what Vaibhav built at IntelligentDX
svg.text: What I build at IntelligentDX, healthtech software for eye-care practices. Intern from April 2025, full-time since November 2025.
Books every visit of a multi-appointment plan with atomic slot reservation, one
audit row per appointment and 200/207/422 responses. In production since
Built on an EHR with no native reschedule: book the new slot first, retry at timed
offsets, report partial success, keep a full audit trail.
Providers × locations × visit types. Cloud Scheduler to Cloud Run Jobs to
PostgreSQL, so indexed reads replace slow or timing-out external calls.
Down from 2.7–3.6 s with a concurrent pager (detail B). Scheduling APIs moved to
the EHR's FHIR R4 API with unchanged contracts.
Lower cost per generated rule from prompt caching. Built around Claude with
validation gates and a repair loop.
Internship: API read paths across 5 C#/.NET microservices in about 8 weeks. 9
Slot-search response time, before and after the concurrent pager. Scale: 1 s = 200 px.
